SELECT T1.CustomerID, T1.Consumption
FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID

FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'SME' AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(Consumption) 
     FROM yearmonth 
     INNER JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
     WHERE customers.Currency = 'CZK' 
       AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212') -
    (SELECT SUM(Consumption) 
     FROM yearmonth 
     INNER JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
     WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR' 
       AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212') AS DifferenceInConsumption

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUM(T1.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
    yearmonth AS T1
JOIN 
    customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T2.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY 
    Year
ORDER BY 
    TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2) AS Month,
    MAX(Consumption) AS PeakConsumption
FROM 
    yearmonth
JOIN 
    customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE 
    customers.Segment = 'SME' AND
    Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY 
    Year, Month
ORDER BY 
    PeakConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH LAM AS (
    SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS LAM_Annual_Average
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND CustomerID IN (
          SELECT CustomerID
          FROM customers
          WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
          ORDER BY Consumption ASC
          LIMIT 1
      )
),
SME AS (
    SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS SME_Annual_Average
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND CustomerID IN (
          SELECT CustomerID
          FROM customers
          WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
          ORDER BY Consumption ASC
          LIMIT 1
      )
),
KAM AS (
    SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS KAM_Annual_Average
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND CustomerID IN (
          SELECT CustomerID
          FROM customers
          WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
          ORDER BY Consumption ASC
          LIMIT 1
      )
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT LAM_Annual_Average FROM LAM) - (SELECT SME_Annual_Average FROM SME) AS LAM_SME_Difference,
    (SELECT LAM_Annual_Average FROM LAM) - (SELECT KAM_Annual_Average FROM KAM) AS LAM_KAM_Difference,
    (SELECT SME_Annual_Average FROM SME) - (SELECT KAM_Annual_Average FROM KAM) AS SME_KAM_Difference

SELECT 
    Segment,
    MAX((SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS MaxPercentageIncrease,
    MIN((SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS MinPercentageDecrease
FROM 
    yearmonth
JOIN 
    customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE 
    customers.Currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY 
    Segment

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29

SELECT 
    P.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS PatientIDs
FROM 
    Patient P
JOIN 
    Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY 
    P.SEX

SELECT AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS AverageAge
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.TG >= 200 AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) > 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.CPK >= 250

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250

SELECT 
    P.ID, 
    P.Diagnosis, 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM 
    Patient P
JOIN 
    Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    L.RBC < 3.5

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND P.HGB BETWEEN 10 AND 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT P.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.`First Date`, P.Admission, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', L.Date) = '1984'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday)) < 50
  AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS AbnormalFibrinogenCount
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.WBC > 3.5 AND L.WBC < 9.0
  AND (L.FG <= 150 OR L.FG >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`aCL IgG` > 900 AND T1.`aCL IgG` < 2000 AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE P.`First Date` >= '1990-01-01' AND L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500

SELECT T2.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGM <= 40 OR T1.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY T2.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE CRP = '+' AND Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5 AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE P.Admission = '+' AND L.RNP IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS PatientCount
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE (E.SM = '-' OR E.SM = '+-') AND E.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL 
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
AND T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') 
AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday) AS Youngest_Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS PositiveCoagulationCount
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CPK < 250
  AND (E.KCT = '+' OR E.RVVT = '+' OR E.LAC = '+')

FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id

LIMIT 1

FROM Team_Attributes

LIMIT 4

FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id

GROUP BY L.id
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    T1.player_name, 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.birthday)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', T1.birthday)) AS age

    Player AS T1
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

    T2.sprint_speed >= 97

FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id

ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT team_fifa_api_id 
FROM Team_Attributes 
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

FROM Team
JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', Team_Attributes.date) = '2012'
AND buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012' AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL)

FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

FROM Player P

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY L.id
HAVING AVG(M.home_team_goal) > AVG(M.away_team_goal)

FROM Player

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

FROM Match

FROM Player P

FROM Player AS t1

    (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN T2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN T2.id ELSE NULL END)) -

    Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

    ((T1.fastestLapSpeed - T2.fastestLapSpeed) / T2.fastestLapSpeed) * 100 AS percentage
FROM 
    results AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2
ON 
    T1.driverId = T2.driverId

    drivers.forename, 
    drivers.surname, 
    races.name, 
    MIN(lapTimes.milliseconds) AS best_lap_time

    lapTimes
JOIN 
    drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId

    races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId

WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
),
OldestFemaleClient AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM FemaleClients
    ORDER BY birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
LowestSalaryDistrict AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A11 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
HighestSalaryDistrict AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A11 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
OldestFemaleClientAccount AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM OldestFemaleClient)
),
LowestSalaryDistrictAccounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM LowestSalaryDistrict)
),
HighestSalaryDistrictAccounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM HighestSalaryDistrict)
),
LowestSalaryGap AS (
    SELECT AVG(A11) - (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM HighestSalaryDistrictAccounts)) AS gap
    FROM district
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM LowestSalaryDistrictAccounts)
)
SELECT account_id, (SELECT gap FROM LowestSalaryGap) AS salary_gap
FROM OldestFemaleClientAccount
